mtls_mutual_authentication.mechanism: rustls TLS 1.3 with custom ServerCertVerifier and ClientCertVerifier; untrusted CAs immediately rejected.

cryptographic_signatures.mechanism: Ed25519 manifest and state transaction signatures; corrupt signatures fail validation.

durability_ack_spoofing.mechanism: Coordinator enforces node_id and shard_id matching; deduplicates via BTreeSet<usize> to prevent count inflation.

pid_reuse_toctou_mitigation.mechanism: Triple-layer protection: Linux pidfd_open/pidfd_send_signal task pinning, starttime matching in cluster.pids, and /proc/{pid}/cmdline verification.

fail_closed_quorum_enforcement.mechanism: Network partitions leaving fewer than K=12 nodes fail closed immediately, preventing split-brain writes.
